items: 2026-11-06: Week 11/2–6 scorecard: 3 up / 9 down, avg −1.88% per call vs SPY −3.17%. HUM/PLNT/CPAY (non-tech beat-and-raises) worked; CI/CDW/RVTY logged into or just before Thu's −4.3% crush lost hard. Paper swing −4.2% vs bench −2.9%.

2026-11-06: Don't log new swing longs into a −4% index day or the session after a sector shock bounce — first green day in AI-hardware was noise; group avoid stayed through 11/10 and was right to keep.
2026-11-06: Skip-open (>5% gap) rule held: ABNB/MRNA stayed green to the close; TEAM/DKNG soft-guide gaps kept falling — log winners at close, never soft-guide gaps.
2026-10-30: Week 10/26–30: 8 up / 8 down / 1 flat, avg +0.14% vs SPY −0.95%. Non-tech beat-and-raises worked; AI-hardware longs lost in the capex scare.

2026-10-23: Big headline gaps fade from the open. For a pre-market gap >5%, skip or log at the close.

2026-10-23: Lab winners must beat SPY and equal-weight on a sealed hold-out (Quant-Arena lesson).
2026-10-16: Re-affirming a winner after a +5% week bought the top; hold but don't re-add.

2026-10-09: Sector shocks need whole-group avoids (telcos on SpaceX; AI-hardware on Nov 5).

RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-11-12)
- Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned (CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO). NVDA fell nearly 12% early and closed about 4% lower; the S&P, Dow and Nasdaq each closed down about 0.3-0.4%.
- Rotation, not panic: AMD, AVGO, GOOGL and AMZN rose, energy gained for a 4th day as oil rose on Iran comments, and the 10-yr stayed above 5%. NBIS, CRWV, IREN and MU slid.
- Our calls: the AI-hardware avoid held up (NBIS about -15% midday). LLY opened higher on its China pill approval but closed about -0.7%. We passed on TTEK's gap, and it faded from $41.50 to $39.43.
- After hours: CSCO up about 5% on a beat and raise (AI hyperscaler revenue target now $9B); AMAT beat but traded mixed. We log CSCO only if the gain holds into Friday's close.
- Next: PPI Friday; NVDA earnings 11/17; HD, TGT, WMT next week; Anthropic IPO talk. The chip avoid stays through 11/18.
